conditions.description: The seeded Layercake.silv_ref_payment_method holds exactly the three reserved rows at fixed ids and the five methods, with byte-exact labels (RULE-006, RULE-078).
conditions.preconditions: Reads the table as deployed and seeded by the module's migration (static list, no load). Not faked, because the seed is what is under test. Assumes Q-015: there is no Mixed value.
conditions.expected: Exactly 8 rows: id 0 'Unknown', id -1 'Unrecognised', id -2 'Not applicable', and 'Direct Debit', 'Card', 'Bank transfer', 'Cheque', 'Corporate' with positive ids. Labels are compared as bytes, so case and spacing must match. The five method ids are exactly 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 (identity from 1), in any order.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-001 seeded payment method list holds the three reserved rows and the five methods]

conditions.description: The seeded payment method list has no Mixed value (RULE-009).
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-015: no Mixed payment method. Reads the deployed, seeded table.
conditions.expected: No row of silv_ref_payment_method has a payment_method_name containing 'Mixed'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-002 seeded payment method list has no Mixed value]

conditions.description: fn_map_payment_method maps the five source codes to their methods, and null and the empty string to Unknown (RULE-007).
conditions.preconditions: Seven inputs: N'DD', N'Card', N'Bank', N'Cheque', N'Corporate', NULL and N''. Each returned id is resolved through the deployed silv_ref_payment_method. The function is scalar, taking one nvarchar(20) code and returning the int id (Mike, 2026-10-26, docs/answers.md). Case and surrounding spaces are covered by TC-003-013.
conditions.expected: DD gives Direct Debit, Card gives Card, Bank gives Bank transfer, Cheque gives Cheque, Corporate gives Corporate (each a positive id). NULL gives 0 (Unknown) and '' gives 0 (Unknown).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-003 the five codes map to their methods and null or empty string to Unknown]

conditions.description: Each of the five method rows in silv_ref_payment_method carries the source payment mode code it maps from (the spec's source_code mapping, RULE-007).
conditions.preconditions: Reads the deployed, seeded table, rows with id > 0. The reserved rows' source_code is not asserted, because neither the spec nor the design sets it.
conditions.expected: Direct Debit 'DD', Card 'Card', Bank transfer 'Bank', Cheque 'Cheque', Corporate 'Corporate'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-004 each method row carries its source payment mode code]

conditions.description: An unrecognised payment mode code maps to Unrecognised, kept separate from Unknown (RULE-008).
conditions.preconditions: Input N'XYZ'. The function is scalar (Mike, 2026-10-26).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-005 code XYZ maps to Unrecognised not Unknown]

conditions.description: Values that are not one of the five codes map to Unrecognised: method names used as codes, partial or extended codes, 'Mixed' and a reserved label (RULE-008, RULE-009).
conditions.preconditions: Inputs N'Direct Debit', N'Bank transfer', N'D', N'DDX', N'Mixed' and N'Unknown'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-006 names partial codes and Mixed map to Unrecognised]

conditions.description: The first dimension load copies every silv_ref_payment_method row, reserved negative ids included, into dim_payment_method with the same id and name, and logs its outcome (RULE-010).
conditions.preconditions: silv_ref_payment_method, dim_payment_method and etl_run_log are faked (the log with identity and defaults). Silver holds 8 rows: 0 Unknown, -1 Unrecognised, -2 Not applicable, 1 Direct Debit, 2 Card, 3 Bank transfer, 4 Cheque, 5 Corporate. The dimension is empty.
conditions.expected: dim_payment_method holds exactly the same 8 (id, name) pairs, with names byte-exact. Exactly one etl_run_log row: status 'Success', rows_inserted 8, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-007 first dimension load copies all eight ids and names and logs Success]

conditions.description: A second dimension load on unchanged silver keeps every name on the same id and changes nothing.
conditions.preconditions: Same faked 8 silver rows as TC-003-007. Empty dimension. Load run twice.
conditions.expected: dim_payment_method is identical in every column (load_id, created_at and updated_at included) after the first and second loads. Names map to ids Unknown 0, Unrecognised -1, Not applicable -2, Direct Debit 1, Card 2, Bank transfer 3, Cheque 4, Corporate 5. etl_run_log holds two 'Success' rows: (8 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted) and (0, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-008 second dimension load keeps every id and changes nothing]

conditions.description: The dimension load inserts missing ids, updates a changed name on its existing id and leaves unchanged rows untouched, so the dimension ends with the same pairs as silver.
conditions.preconditions: Faked silver holds the 8 rows of TC-003-007. The faked dimension holds 0 Unknown, -1 Unrecognised, -2 Not applicable and 1 Direct Debit unchanged, plus 2 'Credit card' (an old name). Every dimension row has load_id 7 and created_at and updated_at 2026-02-01 10:00:00. Ids 3, 4 and 5 are missing.
conditions.expected: The dimension holds exactly the 8 silver pairs, with id 2 now 'Card' (still id 2, no new row). Ids 0, -1, -2 and 1 keep load_id 7 and created_at and updated_at 2026-02-01 10:00:00. One etl_run_log row: 'Success', 3 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-009 dimension load inserts missing ids updates a changed name and leaves unchanged rows untouched]

conditions.description: A dimension name that differs from silver only in case counts as a changed name and is corrected, even though the collation is case-insensitive.
conditions.preconditions: Faked silver: 0 'Unknown', 2 'Card'. Faked dimension: 0 'Unknown', 2 'card' (lower case), load_id 7.
conditions.expected: Dimension id 2 has the exact bytes of 'Card', and id 0 is still 'Unknown'. One etl_run_log row: 'Success', 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-010 dimension load corrects a name that differs only in case]

conditions.description: Error path: a dimension load the target rejects records the error, re-raises it, logs 'Failed' and leaves the dimension unchanged (design error handling: try/catch, logged through usp_etl_log_end, THROW).
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Silver, dimension and etl_run_log are faked, and the design's NOT NULL is put back on the faked dim_payment_method.payment_method_name. Faked silver: 0 'Unknown', 1 'Direct Debit', and 9 with a NULL name. The dimension holds 1 'Direct Debit' (load_id 7).
conditions.expected: Error 515 (cannot insert NULL) reaches the caller. dim_payment_method is identical to before: only id 1 'Direct Debit', and no id 0 or 9 is left from a partial run. Exactly one etl_run_log row, status 'Failed', with a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-011 dimension load failing on a row the target rejects re-raises logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]

conditions.description: Loaded from the deployed seeded list, dim_payment_method has the same row count and the same (id, name) pairs as silv_ref_payment_method.
conditions.preconditions: silv_ref_payment_method is not faked: the seeded list is read. dim_payment_method and etl_run_log are faked. Empty dimension.
conditions.expected: The dimension holds 8 rows: 0 'Unknown', -1 'Unrecognised', -2 'Not applicable', and 'Direct Debit', 'Card', 'Bank transfer', 'Cheque', 'Corporate' on positive ids. No dimension row lacks a silver row with the same id and byte-identical name.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-012 dimension loaded from the seeded list has the same ids and names as the list]

conditions.description: A code that differs from one of the five only in case or leading or trailing spaces maps to that method, and a code of spaces only maps to Unknown (RULE-007, RULE-008 as answered by Mike, 2026-10-26, docs/answers.md).
conditions.preconditions: Eight inputs: N'dd', N' DD', N'Card ', N'  bank  ', N'CHEQUE', N' cOrPoRaTe', N'   ' and N' XYZ '. Each returned id is resolved through the deployed silv_ref_payment_method.
conditions.expected: dd and ' DD' give Direct Debit, 'Card ' gives Card, '  bank  ' gives Bank transfer, CHEQUE gives Cheque, ' cOrPoRaTe' gives Corporate (each a positive id). '   ' gives 0 (Unknown). ' XYZ ' gives -1 (Unrecognised): trimming does not make an unknown code recognised.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-013 codes differing only in case or surrounding spaces map to their method and whitespace only to Unknown]
